batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b MS Gony

batting.name: SE Marsh

batting.name: Azhar Mahmood
batting.dismissal: st PA Patel b A Mishra

batting.name: PP Chawla
batting.dismissal: c CL White b DW Steyn

balls.text: mishits a widish full toss on the bounce to long on
tries to repeat the stroke, this one is quite full, and he scoops it straight to Harris at short fine
Christian walks across and scoops a slow length ball from well outside off past short fine
reaches out to a wide full toss, loses his bat as he gets it to point, who throws late, Mahmood does not like that
that was close to being in the blockhole, almost there, but White winds up and scoops it over the bowler for four more
full toss on off and middle, swung away to deep midwicket
tries to get under this fullish one, but only manages to slam it along the ground to long off, there is yet another fumble, and this time they take the second
almost takes out the bowler as he drills a full ball back to him, Awana takes it close to the knee

this one could have gone as well, it was there to be swung over deep midwicket, this time Christian cannot quite get under it, man in the deep runs across to it, there is another fumble as he tries to pick it up
goes full and close to the blockhole now, Christian manages to get it past short fine, deep square cuts off the four with a slide
another one in the slot, good length again, middle stump line again, another swing from Christian and the ball disappears over deep midwicket rope
Christian now, length ball, on middle, and clobbered over midwicket
he was walking across the stumps as he missed that ball angled just past leg stump, given a wide, never was a bowler's game
White continues to give it to Punjab, those two drops hurting them more and more, length ball flat-batted over long on
pulls hard but straight to deep midwicket, who fumbles, but only a single conceded
he gets under this length ball now, and swings it to the deep midwicket rope, that is fifty for White, how much hurt is in store for Punjab?
played towards backward point
wanted to go in the air down the ground as he made some room outside leg, it was not quite full from Harris and slower too, White adjusts to push to long on
Punjab hold on to a catch, Awana it is at third man, Dhawan slashes a short ball cutting into him in the air, and Awana goes on his knees to take it low, and safely
cannot get underneath this full ball and squeezes it out to long off
heaves a slow length ball out to deep square
again he follows Dhawan who is outside leg, but he skips out and lifts the full delivery over the bowler
White hits the non-striker's stumps again, PK follows him with a full one as he makes room outside leg
squeezes a near-yorker back to the bowler, PK gets a hand to it, and the ball misses the non-striker's stumps to go to long on
slower length ball, he makes some room, waits and bashes it to sweeper cover
low full toss swung down to long on
hits one angled across him to long on
White is looking ominous , drills a pitched up ball straight and takes out the one of non-striker's stumps
high full toss, and White manages to clobber it over midwicket
worked away off the pads behind square leg and they come back for two
they have dropped White again, the Deccan virus has spread, White makes room and drills it straight to Chawla at extra cover, it travelled fast and went down quickly out of his hands

nothing going Chawla's way this over, is appeal for lbw is turned down, Dhawan tries the reverse sweep to a length ball on middle and leg and misses, did that pitch outside leg? yes, comfortably outside, the law has not been changed yet for reverse sweeps
punched to wide long on
Chawla is fuming, now a misfield at backward point from Mahmood, Dhawan had backed away and cut from middle
down to long for a single

Harris has dropped a straightforward catch at wide long off, White mishit the legbreak in the air, Harris got across to his left and had it covered with both hands, but it pops out from about chest height
upper cuts a short ball outside off to third man
another one towards White's pads, and he shuffles to tickle it away fine
backs away outside leg, Harris follows him from back of a length, the pull is mistimed to midwicket, whose throw misses at the non-striker's, Dhawan was gone had it hit
tries to swing him over midwicket with the angle, thick inside edge dribbles away to deep square
steered down to third man for one
that one came back in sharply from a good length outside off, White is surprised and gets bat down just in time to stab it towards midwicket
shuffles and turns a length ball from off and middle through midwicket
bends his knee and steers a full and wide one to third man
tight line around off, White runs it down to third man
mishit down to long off as he tries to hammer this back of a length ball from the crease
he is standing a mile outside off stump even before the ball has been delivered, and takes it the length ball from thereabouts and scoops it, it carries just over the fine leg rope, incredible
gave him the charge right away as he made room outside leg, Awana slants it full and wide across him, gets it through point, Mahmood gets a boot in the way as he runs across from third man
now the reverse sweep, connects well with the fullish delivery and earns four to the fine third man rope
the runs are coming quickly now, tossed up on middle, and he works it neatly for a couple in front of square leg
fifth fifty this season for Dhawan with a single down the ground
Dhawan continuing his good form, picks this one from middle and leg, and deposits it over square leg, not off the middle of the bat but he still gets maximum
pushes a length ball from outside off down to long on
down the track, it is pushed through flat across him, he adjusts to hit it to sweeper cover
poor end to the over from PK, again he strays on to the pads, and is again punished fine down the leg side
worked to midwicket's left, but a big dive saves the single
sends it on the pads from a good length, and is put away fine past the keeper
hops and steers a bouncer outside off to third man
pushed softly off the back foot, and they go through for a sharp single
goes hard at this one outside off, sliced in the air down to third man
short and angled in to White, who takes it on, and pulls it hard behind square leg, beats fine leg easily
slower one floated up, he is a touch late in picking it, and adjusts to push it through extra cover
worked away to midwicket for a single
defended back to the bowler
now he hammers it to Mandeep's left at sweeper cover, more running and more diving saves a run this time
charges out and carves it over point, Mandeep runs across from sweeper cover and his dive saves the four
moves well forward to smother a tossed up ball, Dhawan wants the single but is rightly sent back
worked off the pad through midwicket for a couple
darts across him flat, he was on the back foot, and reaches out to slap it in the air down to long off, checked his stroke in the end
turns in towards middle and off from a good length, he was backing away to cut, adjusts to dab it towards point
this time he decides to step down the track, and lifts the half volley over the bowler
turns in as it is tossed up fullish outside off, pushed back to the bowler
shortish now, he rides the bounce and works it wide of fine leg
full, on the pads, and White flicks it nicely through midwicket, mid on gives up the chase early
right forward and smothers it in defence to the off side
eases a pitched up ball from middle and leg to long off
plays this length ball from the crease, and is squared up slightly as the thick edge races to third man
steered to third man

and the wide slip has taken out Sanga, similar to the way he fell in the first game against Kings XI, to PK, this time it is Awana, who gets it to bounce a tad from back of a length, Sanga is forward to defend, it moves away a bit, and the thick edge is snapped up low to his right by an alert Mahmood
pushes a short of a length ball to point from the crease
pitched fuller, and around off, he gets forward and drives it neatly down to long off
plays out one going across him to point
angles it across Sanga, who gets forward and slaps it to sweeper cover
shuffles but cannot work the short of a length ball away from the bowler, who runs to the on side and fields
Parthiv goes trying to target the on side, walks across, and tries to lift this length ball from outside off over midwicket, the steepler is taken by the fielder at midwicket
comes down the track, Mahmood shortens the length, Dhawan stops and pulls it in front of square
again this one holds its line, this time on middle, he makes some room to squeeze it out towards cover
allows it to come on and pushes it softly on the off side
holding its line just outside off stump, he stays in the crease and dabs it past point and wide of third man
tucks a back of a length ball off pad to short fine
now moves across and turns a length delivery off middle to midwicket, they see PK is slow to the ball, and decide to risk the second, direct hit was needed again, not happening
comes down the track, wants to carve it through the off side, the ring is packed with fielders though, cover fields
hit high on the thigh pad with one that follows him down the leg side from short of a length, goes down to third man
back of a length again, but there was width, and Parthiv winds up to clobber it over cover
mishit towards point for one
tries to throw him off track, moves a leg towards the on side, has to quietly push a back of a length ball on the off side
tucked through midwicket for one
makes a bit of room, comes down the pitch and thumps this length ball well over mid on
slowish on the pads, he flicks but straight to square leg now
well-timed push to a length ball but straight to mid off
slices a full one in the air down to third man
again they attempt a risky single, again the throw misses from extra cover, and this time the backing-up isn't good
direct hit and he was way out, but Mandeep runs in from extra cover and fires in a wayward throw at the striker's end which misses by miles
tries to get forward and drive through extra cover, but it was not full enough, shaping away, and he adjusts to push on to the off side
full delivery now, worked through midwicket
consistently getting it to swing across the left-hander from a good length, pushed towards cover
just around off stump from a good length, Parthiv shuffles but can only push it back to PK
finishes the over with a flighted ball, again bit of width given outside off, and Dhawan, even though he does not time it, manages to hit it just over the wide long-on rope
back to firing it in to the pads, worked through square leg
this time he tosses it up wide outside off, and it is put away without fuss past extra cover
works a full delivery through midwicket
angled in full on to the pads, turned to short fine
worked to midwicket
fired it quick and down the leg side from around the stumps
tighter line now, pushed away quietly towards point
more width, and this time he cuts, again cannot beat the infield
stays in the crease as a length ball swings across, bit of wdith, guided straight to cover though
ending on off this time after pitching on a length on middle, he pushes it towards mid off and they go through for one
that will go, too wide and full from PK as he tries to angle it across, and Dhawan reaches out to slap it through extra cover
swinging across the left-hander right away, pitching around middle and leg, he lets it go
Gurkeerat has done it for Punjab with a boundary, and Mohali is ecstatic, short ball in to the body, and Gurkeerat hooks it away to the fine leg rope
somehow gets it in the air wide of extra cover, they will risk the second, they have to, Gurkeerat is not making it, he has too much ground to cover, but a big dive, a massive dive, and he is in
super stuff, Gurkeerat, gets away another boundary, wide of sweeper cover this time, full, just outside off, he again makes some room and opens the face to get the placement right
oh boy, Gurkeerat has made room to the short of a length ball, cleared front leg and dragged it just over the deep midwicket rope
hammers a length ball flat and on the bounce to long on
heaves a length ball angled into him through square leg, there is a fumble in the deep, and Hussey is back on strike
can Punjab do it, Gurkeerat makes room and squeezes a low full toss past a diving point
heaves a full toss to midwicket, who has a go at the stumps, Hussey was gone had the throw hit, Steyn is furious at the fielder, Sudhindra, for throwing
that would have taken out the middle stump, it was a yorker at 145.4 kph, Hussey got bat down on it as he backed away to have a swing
throws his bat at a pitched up ball outside off, flies down to third man
in the blockhole outside off, squeezed out to point, still some late away swing for Steyn
drags a full one from outside off to long on
full toss pushed to cover for one

no idea how that has gone for four, but it has, it was a mile outside off, Gurkeerat goes walking two miles outside off, he does not quite get bat on it as he tries to scoop it, probably bit of thigh pad as well as it scoots past the keeper on the leg side
full delivery has been drilled straight past Hussey and has too much pace on it for long on
goes for the blockhole outside leg stump, swung off a thick inside edge through square leg
that has gone, Christian's slower one has been lifted over deep midwicket, just wide of the man and just over the rope
slower length ball on middle and leg, he makes room and pushes it on the off side
right in the blockhole on the stumps, Hussey opens up but can only dig it back to Steyn
runs a short of a length ball down to third man
slower one gets Chawla, pushes out to a length ball and scoops it up to backward point
that almost went for six, 145.1 kph short ball from Steyn, Chawla was scrambling away from the line, but managed to steer it past the keeper
he went full and quick for the stumps, Chawla got the bat down in time and managed to get it behind point
Steyn strikes first ball on return, Chitnis backs away and swings at a length ball only to thick edge it to a diving Parthiv
cannot hit the blockhole last ball, ends up as a low full toss, and Hussey launches it down the ground to reach his 50
another one around the blockhole, squeezed out to extra cover
close to the blockhole, hit to long on
cannot get this full delivery outside off away
hit hard down to long on
turns a low full toss through midwicket, a slight fumble in the deep and they come back for the second
and another one, can Deccan still lose this one? Hussey mows this flighted one over wide long on
now he charges out and lifts a short and flat delivery over the bowler, Hussey keeping Punjab in the hunt
low full toss hit wide of long on for two
way too short and flat, into Hussey with the angle, and he slams it high over deep midwicket
eases a full one from middle over the bowler, long on scrambles across and manages to stop it
drags a generously tossed up ball, Ramesh Powar style, from outside off down to long on
back of a length ball patted towards cover
now he has a swing at a short ball and misses
ducks underneath a bouncer angled into him outside leg stump
short and wide outside off, and he slams it powerfully wide of extra cover
on off stump from a good length this time, worked to midwicket
length ball goes well down the leg side
opens up outside leg stump, Gony follows him with a length ball, swung through square leg
slapped away to sweeper cover
flatter outside off, cuts it away to sweeper cover
pushes forward in defence, it is the googly, turns in and he takes it on the pad outside the line of off
Mishra gets Mahmood, flights it very wide and full outside off, Mahmood charges out, misses and Parthiv does the rest
short and flat outside off, flat-batted down to long off
very full again, he was dropping it too short earlier in the over, worked through midwicket
goes for the blockhole again, hit down to long on
works a full delivery to midwicket, Hussey gets his bat down just as the throw hits the non-striker's stumps
short, sitting up outside off, and Hussey thumps it way over deep midwicket
squeezes out a yorker outside off to point, who cannot decide whether to throw or not, and in the end, the ball dribbles out after a half-attempt
Mahmood gets four, makes room outside leg, and cuts a shortish delivery one bounce into the deep backward point rope
opens up but Steyn cramps him with a length ball on leg, pushed away on the leg side
right on middle and leg from a good length, he stays in the crease and blocks
that will go, Hussey making some room, Steyn providing some width from back of a length, and Hussey cracks the cut past backward point
shot! stands in the crease and eases a pitched up ball along the ground but extra cover dives to his right to stop it
back of a length widish outside off, away to third man
opens the face to a pitched up delivery moving away slightly and runs it wide of third man
backs away outside leg, Gony follows him with a short one, he tries to dab it over the keeper, misses
Hussey this time, clears front leg, and mows a pitched up ball down the ground, mid on can only watch
pulls a short one down to fine leg
makes room now and cuts a shortish one, straight to point though
smacked over midwicket, in the slot on a good length on the stumps, and he gives it a healthy swing
drills a very full one from middle and off to Sanga at mid off, he charges at it, and it goes through him
cuts a shortish one turning away, to sweeper cover
works a full one through midwicket, man from the deep runs in to keep them to one, a much sharper version of Chargers on display today
gets forward to a length ball and pushes it down the pitch
goes for the cut again, this one bounces a bit and he mistimes it completely
cuts a flatter one through point, and it is timed well enough to beat sweeper cover in the deep
wanted to go over midwicket as he saw some flight, but in the end pushed it on the off side
pegged back by a short of a length ball, runs it to the left of point who dives to stop it
pulled in the air through square leg
goes deep in the crease to defend towards point, a misfield allows him to get off the mark
weaves out of the way of a 141.7 kph bouncer just outside off

another one heaves out to midwicket, Mandeep looked to back away and pull a short of a length ball angled in, did not time it, midwicket was right on the edge of the circle and went to his right to take a straightforward catch
swivels and swings a length ball off the pad behind square
shortish and too much angle into the pads, Mandeep uses it to pull it well wide of fine leg
allows it to come on and steers to third man
pulled away through midwicket for three as it is stopped just inside

looks to smash a length ball down the ground, mishit to mid off, who lets rip with the throw, which makes Christian fall as he takes evasive action, and pings White on his wrist as he backs up, Sunil Gavaskar would not have liked that piece of throwing, Mahmood was safe
makes some room and punches a length ball from middle to extra cover
controls the pull very well behind square leg, fine leg's dive is in vain, but deep square is right behind him to save the four
third man is up, the ball is full and just outside off, and Mandeep has made room to slice it over that fielder
no stopping this one, pitched up again, he powers it straight past the bowler
super stop from White at extra cover, Mandeep had drilled a near-yorker to White's left, and he dives in time to save the boundary
runs a back of a length ball to third man
lifted way over long on, no fuss at all, picks up a length ball from off and times it into the crowd
jams his bat down on a yorker on off and digs it out to extra cover
pushed off the front foot towards extra cover
Christian is down on a knee after umpire Dharmasena turns down a confident lbw appeal, but that length ball would have gone down leg with the angle

Sanga takes another catch, Christian another wicket, the big one of Marsh, who looked to heave a length ball from just outside off over midwicket, off the inner part of the bat to Sanga who takes a sharp high catch
turned off the pads past midwicket, Dhawan runs across in the deep and fields
stands in the crease, bends the knee and slams a length ball but straight to cover
defends a pitched up ball on middle to extra cover
down the track, too close to the pitch and mishits it to the bowler
shortish, flat and outside off, cut to point
now Mandeep, Jhunjhunwala continues around the stumps, it is not quite short, but he goes down on his knee and swings him just over square leg
pushes a full delivery down to long off
another four, now he goes shortish outside off, Marsh rocks back and eases it through point
tossed up down the leg side and swept easily wide of short fine
squeezes a very full one down the pitch and into the non-striker's stumps, been a few of these today
short of a length and angled into him, pulled away instantly over midwicket off the front foot
drills a full delivery down the pitch, Christian gets down in time and stops it
misses as he looks to cut a wide one

Sanga shows the way with a neat tumbling take at extra cover, Saini wanted to work this length ball off the pads on the leg side, but the leading edge went high over extra cover, there was another fielder, White, close by but he stopped and Sanga completed the catch

Christian and Parthiv are convinced that there was an edge on this attempted drive to a wide and full one which moved away slightly, there was a sound as the ball passed the bat, umpire Dharmasena shakes his head
back of a length to end the over, he mistimes a pull on the bounce to mid on
defends a pitched up ball
chance of a run out as he pushes a length ball in the air and on the bounce to an advancing mid off who throws at the keeper's end, Parthiv comes in but cannot gather it
comes down the track and tries to hammer this short of a length ball down the ground, mishits it to mid on
another one back of a length, pulled away through square leg
swings a short of a length ball down to fine leg
short of a length and down the leg side at 133.5 kph
hurled fullish into the pads and rolls away to fine leg
short of a length, too close to cut, squeezed out to point
pitched further up around off, pushed in the air wide of extra cover
angles it on to the pads looking for the away movement, carries straight on, hits him on the pads, rolls away square on the leg side
moving away from a good length outside off, pushed towards cover
pushes a length ball to mid off
